name: starlette-398e5a34-blind29-ots
instr:
# Starlette: wrong statuses, lost headers and broken pass-throughs, without a test suite

We pinned an upgrade of this web framework and a long list of unrelated-looking problems appeared at once, so here is everything we could observe from the outside. The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about the protocol changed and nothing about our own code changed; calls that used to be served correctly now come back wrong, and in several places a call that used to succeed fails outright.

Take first what a caller sees when something goes wrong. An endpoint that blows up with an uncaught RuntimeError, with debug mode on, still renders the HTML traceback page naming RuntimeError, but the status line reads 501 instead of 500. With debug off the short plain-text body arrives with 501 as well, and 501 is also what comes back when reading a file off disk fails with a TimeoutError. Raising a 304 from an endpoint now returns 304 with the status phrase written into the body, where the body used to be empty. When we register a routine for a particular failure type, the answer we receive is not the one it produces: posting a body to an endpoint that reads it and raises yields neither the 422 status nor the JSON echo of the body that the registered routine writes, and something registered against a more general failure type appears to win instead. And when a websocket endpoint raises a failure whose registered routine is a plain synchronous function, the socket neve
